references.text: The parallel account in Numbers about the sending of the spies, where Moses sent twelve men, one from each tribe, to explore the land of Canaan.
Moses' instructions to the twelve spies on what they should investigate in the land.
The list of one man from each tribe who was chosen, showing the principle of representation from each of the twelve tribes.
Previous verses describing the people's suggestion to send spies, which Moses here responds to positively.
A similar expression 'it pleased' (וַיִּיטַב) used for something that was well received, here by Pharaoh and his servants.
